requiredSections: Skill entry point and progressive disclosure
platformRules: Keep the reusable SKILL.md instructions distinct from Claude Project instructions and standalone SDK applications.
Use bounded progressive disclosure with resolvable relative references; list supporting scripts and their side effects for review without running them.
Record host availability and code-execution prerequisites as deployment checks, never permission to enable them.
Review authorized knowledge and intended sharing audience before manual upload; skills do not grant source access or bypass confirmations.
